title: Publish native-memory 0.3.3 and remove application source from release archives
body:
Publish the seven reviewed wheels and nine Ed25519 signatures, and update installation documentation with download and verification commands. The release tag points to an independent commit containing only release notes and LICENSE, so GitHub-generated ZIP/tar archives do not include Aimee application source.

The existing signed wheel bytes are unchanged. The docs explicitly distinguish repository source archives from Python/Triton runtime files inside the wheels.

Validation: all seven wheel hashes and nine signatures verified; eight native-memory release verifier tests passed. Publication workflow verifies exact bytes before uploading.
head: release/native-memory-0.3.3-publish
